correctness.rationale: Unitary Mellin diagonalization yields m(xi)=pi/cosh(pi xi) and the normalized Gamma-transform density 1/cosh(pi xi). The rank-one Birman-Schwinger denominator is an exactly integrable angular Stieltjes function; strict derivative sign and vector nonvanishing give the entire real point-spectrum classification and exclude threshold/interior eigenstates. Puiseux and logarithmic expansions yield the precise quadratic versus exponential edge constants. The seven-file package reproduces 83 numerical consistency assertions; analytic quantifiers rest on the proof.

value.rationale: The Carleman operator is a natural noncompact positive Hankel model, and one canonical normalized exponential rank-one perturbation creates two qualitatively different bound-state onset scales at opposite spectral edges. Explicit sharp prefactors and exactly solvable landmarks quantify the disparity invisible in existing eigenvalue-count theorems; this supports comparison of threshold spectral responses rather than a routine reparameterization.
